statement: A description restated by hand in a second file drifts when only the first is edited. #441 rewrote the B6 protected_path_review_gate metric description in repo-signals.ts to say only a CODEOWNERS file where GitHub reads it, or a policy document that is not a changelog, record, review note or report, counts. The certificate glossary is a separate hand-written string in certificate-presentation.ts, so certificates kept telling readers that any CODEOWNERS file or any documentation counted, for a check that no longer credits either. The binary-outcome line beside it still says 'no CODEOWNERS ... detected' for a repository whose CODEOWNERS sits where GitHub does not read it. Rule: when a metric description changes, grep the metric name across every presentation file and update or flag each reader-facing restatement in the same PR.
